Attach to Thanos. If Thanos is not in play, attach to the villain.
Permanent.
Forced Response: After a hero or villain deals 3 or more damage to the attached character with a single attack, attach this card to the attacking hero or villain.
Hero Action: Spend 2 resources of any type → attach this card to another hero.
